label: artwork
name: Artwork Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR artwork image into one or more detailed categories based on the artistic medium, production technique, visual style, and composition.

labels.painting: An image primarily showing artwork created with paint, such as an oil painting, watercolor painting, acrylic painting, or painted canvas.
labels.drawing: An image primarily showing finished hand-drawn artwork created with pencil, pen, charcoal, ink, or similar materials.
labels.sketch: An image primarily showing a rough, loose, preliminary, or unfinished hand-drawn artwork.
labels.sculpture: An image primarily showing a three-dimensional artistic object, statue, carving, or sculpted figure.
labels.digital_art: An image primarily showing an artistic composition created using digital painting, rendering, or image-editing tools.
labels.illustration: An image primarily showing a drawn or digitally illustrated visual such as character artwork, a storybook image, a stylized scene, or a designed illustration.
labels.cartoon: An image primarily showing a simplified, humorous, or exaggerated drawn character or scene.
labels.comic: An image primarily showing comic panels, sequential scenes, or illustrated storytelling without important readable text.
labels.anime: An image primarily showing characters or scenes illustrated in an anime-style visual form.
labels.mural: An image primarily showing a large painted artwork created directly on a wall, ceiling, or building surface.
labels.collage: An image primarily showing artwork created by combining multiple photographs, papers, textures, or visual elements.
labels.craft: An image primarily showing handmade decorative artwork such as pottery, paper craft, embroidery, woodcraft, or handmade ornaments.
labels.mosaic: An image primarily showing artwork formed from many small pieces of tile, glass, stone, or another material.
labels.textile_art: An image primarily showing artistic work created using fabric, weaving, embroidery, knitting, or other textile techniques.
labels.calligraphy: An image primarily showing decorative or artistic handwriting where the lettering style is the main visual subject and readable text is not essential.
